citations.assessment: The exact Megillah gloss identifies the epithet as meaning from Biri.
Megalleḥin is the chapter of Moed Katan. R. Elazar is named through Ulla and R. Ḥelbo at the same location.
The express chain concerns tearing at the destruction of Judaean towns, Jerusalem and the Temple.
The tractate’s closing teaching gives Ulla Bira’ah in the name of R. Elazar, without R. Ḥelbo in the checked Bavli version.
The Yerushalmi gives Ulla Biraya and R. Elazar in R. Ḥanina’s name for the burning of a Torah scroll.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.reason: No exact Abaye exchange was located under Ulla Bira’ah. The adjacent Ulla bar Rav notice has a different patronymic in the checked Megillah passage.
